High risk
This matches the phishing message impersonating an organisation that Scamwatch (ACCC) warns about. Don't open the link and don't enter any passwords, codes or card details.
Key findings
•
It says there's a problem with your account or asks you to verify it: “account has been locked”.
•
It asks you to log in, verify or enter details through the link: “Verify your details now at”.
•
commbank-secure-login-verify.xyz carries CommBank's name, but it isn't CommBank's domain (commbank.com.au) — the name has other words added to it.
What isn't certain
•
Apollo can't confirm who actually sent this — a pattern match supports the assessment but isn't proof about the sender.
•
TC FlyBy's search found no record for commbank-secure-login-verify.xyz: ApolloSG's knowledge base has nothing on commbank-secure-login-verify.xyz.
•
Not taken further, because it couldn't change the outcome or what to do: impersonation: whether the material genuinely comes from CommBank.
•
Not taken further, because it couldn't change the outcome or what to do: message and deception analysis of the submitted material (requests, pressure, persuasion, intent).
What you can do
•
Don't open the link and don't enter any passwords, codes or card details.
•
Go to the organisation through its official app or a website address you type yourself, or call the number on your card or statement.
•
Report it to Scamwatch at scamwatch.gov.au. If you've already entered details, contact the organisation now and change your password.
